conditions: 6 AM—Greetings on a bittersweet morning here in Teton Village. Bitter for the fading of another wild, winter season and sweet for the fresh collection of memories we've gathered on "The Big One." Come create a few more as we corn-shred our way through the final Saturday. Early morning sunshine will give way to mostly cloudy conditions that threaten a rogue shower or two this afternoon. Blown by southwest winds in the 10-40 mph range, the infiltrating cloud cover will move quickly across the skyscape. High temperatures will be on the mild side, as the summit teases the 40-degree mark and the base reaches the mid-50s. Come without a master plan because those who seek seldom find. When freed from conventional concepts of every kind, knowledge of sublime nonsense becomes the navigator of your mind. -Lege
